evals.name: waiting-register
evals.prompt: 看板现在有什么需要我处理的吗？有的话按紧急程度列一下，顺便看看 loop 健不健康。
evals.expected_output: Opens doctor + console once, leads with a waiting digest (questions, pending acceptance), then health; no board writes.

evals.name: stuck-progress
evals.prompt: 有张卡在 in_progress 停了好久没动，我想知道卡在哪、现在是谁在处理、下一步该谁动。
evals.expected_output: Reads the card with comments/reports/relations/sessions, reports status, holder, heartbeat age, last activity, what is left and the next actor; never heartbeats/claims/steals.

evals.name: answer-awaiting
evals.prompt: 帮我把那张 awaiting 的卡的疑问回复掉，就按你觉得最合适的方案来。
evals.expected_output: Finds the open question, reads the whole round, shows the exact comment body and `--as-human comment add` command before writing, and knows awaiting auto-requeues (do not move again).

evals.name: accept-review
evals.prompt: 有卡进 in_review 了，帮我验收掉吧。
evals.expected_output: Reads acceptance_mode, the current-round report and review verdict, shows coverage and the exact close, declines without evidence, and re-reads after the write.
